races.label: Human
races.description: The most common and adaptable people, found in every corner of the world.

races.label: Elf
races.description: Graceful, long-lived people with a deep connection to nature and magic. An abstract ancestry: play one of its subraces, not the generic elf.

races.label: Common Elf
races.description: The baseline playable elf. A subrace that overrides nothing — it inherits the elf parent's phase, speed, size, ability modifiers, and traits unchanged. Use this to play a 'plain' elf.

races.label: Green Elf
races.description: Forest-dwelling elves bound to the living wood. Inherits the elf base; speed and size carry over from the parent.

races.label: Black Elf
races.description: Subterranean elves of the lightless deeps. A subrace that OVERRIDES the elf phase (wood → water), showing how descent need not preserve every trait.

races.label: Dwarf
races.description: Sturdy, industrious folk carved from the mountain stone itself. An abstract ancestry: play one of its subraces.

races.label: Common Dwarf
races.description: The baseline playable dwarf. A subrace that overrides nothing — it inherits the dwarf parent's phase, speed, size, ability modifiers, and traits unchanged. Use this to play a 'plain' dwarf.

races.label: Hill Dwarf
races.description: Dwarves of the rolling foothills, closer to soil than ore. Inherits the dwarf base but OVERRIDES its phase (metal → earth).

races.label: Mountain Dwarf
races.description: Dwarves of the high peaks and deep mines. Inherits the dwarf base, phase included.

races.label: Beastman
races.description: A TEMPLATE, not a race you play. It defines the shape of anthropomorphic beastfolk so users can author their own kin (catman, wolfman, ratman, …). Kin are SISTERS: each declares its own phase, attributes, speed, size, and traits, and need share nothing mechanical with the others — only the template's shape and the 'beastfolk' kinship.

races.label: Catman
races.description: An agile feline beastfolk. A kin of the beastman template — fully self-defined, sharing nothing mechanical with other beastfolk.

races.label: Wolfman
races.description: A wild, pack-bonded lupine beastfolk. A sister kin to the catman with an entirely different phase, attributes, and traits — the template imposes shape, not commonality.
